_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). Beat templates for the four filler families in docs/design/campaign.md section 1: training_day, rivalry_game, tournament, rescue. Same shape as beat_templates.json (slots, templates, beats, samples). Slots only; no new lore or names; main-story beats are Orb's and appear here only as labelled empty slots. Follows Legal mc01 to mc03, ln05 and c08, and the voice bibles. Claude-written; unmarked by Orb; unscreened by Legal for the filler kinds.

new_slots.episode_number: The main episode a filler episode follows, as a whole number n; the card reads n.5. Absent for a standalone filler episode.
new_slots.side_place: The place on the ring that shows a side story (its name).
new_slots.round: A whole number and its total (round 2 of 3) for a game or a tournament. Never a score of damage or deaths.
new_slots.contest: What a rivalry game or a tournament is played for: a clean launch, a race along the ring, a best of three. Never a count of wreckage or of the lost.
new_slots.stranded: A cast fighter who is stranded across the ring by wrecked ground or a flooded valley (a rescue). Never a captive and never a victim.
new_slots.guest: A cast fighter who drops in to a filler episode.

lines.text: Training ground! My favourite kind of place!
Don't get excited. Warm-up first.
Your guard's dropping. Fix it.
Okay! Show me how!
Training? Is there a wreck to hit?
The practice wall is cracked. Careful.
Easy with the wall! Aim at me!
Final drill. Hit me if you can.
Bring it! Best lesson yet!
Class dismissed. Tomorrow, a harder drill.
Best of three. Loser picks the ground.
Deal! I'm hungry for a win!
Round one goes to the Rival.
One down! Next round!
Make room, rats. We're playing too.
This is a private game.
Last rounds. Nobody holds back now.

samples.slots: opp=RIVAL, round=3 of 3, contest=best of three

lines.text: Final round. The winner picks the ground.
Everything rides on this one.
A rematch is promised. The loser picks.
Round one on the stage. Four fighters.
A tournament! This is great!
First round. Don't embarrass me.
I signed up too. Is food free?
Gahaha! Even the stage trembles!
The final. One fighter takes the stage.
The title is ours, rat!
A winner is crowned. A rematch is coming.
A fighter is stranded across the ring.
Then let's go and fetch them!
Turn back. The road is mine.
About time! I'm starving down here!
The ground is giving way near the route.
Hurry! Fly over it!
Win, rat, and take your friend home!
Safe at last. But how did they get there?

provenance.ai_drafted: Every line in this file's samples is drafted by Claude (Anthropic), from the voice bibles. Each sample line carries source: claude.
provenance.orbs: No line is Orb's. Orb's own marks, rewrites and choices will be recorded here when they come; none is recorded yet.
provenance.main_story_slots: Hold no text at all. When Orb writes them, those lines are Orb's, with source: orb.
provenance.public_statement: The public AI statement names categories (text and dialogue), never vendors, and never claims a line as human-written unless this record shows it (Legal RL-153).

legal_mc06.rule: Any main-story change slot (a fighter changes in Orb's story: a form gained, a side switched) triggers by story position or by an explicit authored choice only, never by how a fighter fared against the player. Its outcomes are a fixed authored list.

ORB.change.fighter.what: A fighter changes in the main story (a form gained, a side switched).
never_triggered_by: how the fighter fared against the player
ORB.change.fighter.outcomes: A fixed list Orb authors (empty until Orb writes it); the generator may pick only from it, in the order or by the choice Orb authors.

legal_mc06.filler: Filler has no change slot at all: no filler template changes a fighter.
